people.imagined: In the Pool House, she has turned a sitter's chair so the person faces away from the basin. She herself looks only into the water at the sitter's reflection, never at the sitter, with an even, unfriendly calm.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the rim of a round stone basin of still water in the Pool House, she looks DOWN into it with her head bowed and her eyes fixed on a reflection, deliberately not looking up at the viewer. Face: a smooth, composed, pale oval face, ageless at about forty; downcast long-lidded dark eyes; thin level brows; a small straight nose; thin lips, neutral and cold; a faint blue thread-shadow from the collar on her chin. Hair: black, in a tight high knot pinned with one long thin brush of pale jade; no other ornament. Body: slim, straight, still. Clothing: three layers of fine undyed grey silk, perfectly pressed, the crossed collars edged with a thin BLUE thread, a pale ink-wash gauze over-robe painted with faint drifting clouds that falls to the floor like mist; wide sleeves whose cuffs are stained solid black with ink; a grey sash with a small blue-green jade pendant. Hands and objects: in the right hand a fine long brush poised over a sheet of pale paper laid flat on a low table (no drawing), the left hand flat on the basin's rim; the basin of black still water holds the pale oval of the viewer's reflection. Power: a faint blue-teal water qi gathers on the surface of the basin and a few cool motes drift up past her sleeve. Background: a hushed pale studio of cloud-grey walls and a round window, soft mist at the floor. Light: cool moonlike light from the upper left, a shimmer of blue-green spirit-light reflected from the water on her chin and the underside of her jaw. Expression: a calm, cool, unfriendly face with lowered lids and eyes fixed on the water, mouth level, giving nothing.

people.imagined: Early morning at the grinding stone, teaching a novice the one-breath stroke. He has demonstrated once, and now holds his open right palm up to show the ink in it, as if this were the lesson.
people.subject: The moment: at a stone ink-slab in the first light of morning he holds his open RIGHT palm up toward the viewer as if showing a lesson, a long inkstick in the other hand. Face: a lean, calm, weathered face of about fifty, brown and lined from a fisher's youth; patient narrow grey eyes; thin grey brows; a long nose; a small neat grey beard; a closed, gentle mouth. Sun-creases run from his eyes like fishing-line. Hair: grey, tied in a small knot on top and pinned with a plain brush of pale bone. Body: tall, narrow, upright, long hands. Clothing: layered robes of fine undyed grey silk with two crossed collars, an over-robe of pale ink-wash gauze painted with drifting clouds, wide sleeves cut generously so the solid black ink-stained cuffs frame his raised palm; a grey sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects (the palm must read): the right palm is stained so deeply black with ink that the lines of the hand look like a tattoo, a dark inky pattern covering the whole palm and fingers, held up facing the viewer; in the left hand a long black inkstick; before him a dark stone ink slab with a pool of ink. Power: a thin ripple of blue-teal water qi circles the inked palm, and a few pale motes rise from the ink pool like drifting mist. Background: a quiet abbey room of soft grey cloud-shadow and a window opening on a sea of mist. Light: pearly dawn light from the upper left with a gentle rim glow along his sleeve and a faint blue-green shimmer. Expression: a patient, quiet, nearly smiling calm, eyes soft and unhurried, the face of a man who believes the stroke can only be taught by being shown once.

people.imagined: Grinding ink for the hundredth time. He starts the stroke, draws his breath in halfway, stops, frowns, puzzled, and looks at his thumbs, which smell of pine.
people.subject: The moment: at a grinding slab he has stopped mid-stroke with an inkstick in his hand and is frowning at his own thumb in gentle puzzlement. Face: a plain, round, open young face of about eighteen with a slight, patient puzzlement; mild brown eyes; soft brows tilted; a short nose; a small closed mouth. A faint grey streak of ink is on his left cheek where he has rested his hand. Hair: black, short, a little untidy, with a thin brush stuck in it a little crooked. Body: slim, a little awkward, rounded shoulders. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of undyed grey silk with two crossed collars showing at the neck, wide sleeves falling in soft folds, the cuffs stained black with ink; a pale grey gauze outer layer faintly painted with a single cloud; a grey sash. Hands and objects: the thumbs of both hands show a clear amber-brown sticky resin stain under the nails, the near thumb lifted for the viewer; the other hand holds a long black inkstick over a dark stone slab; a small block of pale pine resin glows amber beside it. Background: a hushed grey room with a shelf of small ink-cakes and a neat pile of washed brushes dissolving into cloud-grey mist. Light: soft misty spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle pale rim light along his cheek and sleeve, a faint drifting green mote or two from the resin. Expression: a gentle, puzzled frown with the brow drawn together, lips parted a little and eyes fixed on his own thumb.

people.imagined: At the ink house, tending a pot where agarwood burns slowly to soot. She is humming, and she leans her head toward the smoke without noticing it clings to her hair.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a small burner with a thread of dark smoke rising, she lifts her head and smiles warmly at the viewer, a curl of smoke wrapping her loose hair. Face: a round, soft, warm face of about twenty, golden-brown; bright dark eyes with laugh lines; soft arched brows; a small nose with a smudge of soot; a wide generous mouth in a smile. Her cheeks are rounded with the smile and faintly pink from the heat of the little burner. Hair: black, long, worn loose over one shoulder with a small silver clasp, visible wisps of pale grey smoke curling through it and clinging, the main feature. Body: small, sturdy, round-shouldered. Clothing: layered undyed grey silk, soft and fine, two crossed collars, a pale painted-cloud gauze scarf over the shoulders, wide sleeves loosely tied back with a silk cord, the cuffs stained solid black with ink; a grey sash with a tassel. Hands and objects: a small jade-green incense burner with a glowing coal and a dark resinous lump of agarwood, a thin plume of smoke; in the other hand a flat bone spoon with a dark soot scraping. Power: slow blue-teal motes drift up with the smoke and curl into little cloud shapes around her hair. Background: shelves of small black ink cakes glinting softly in a haze of fragrant mist. Light: warm hazy glow from the burner on her face, a pearly spirit-light from the upper left and a soft rim light through the smoke. Expression: a warm, generous, relaxed smile with the eyes crinkled, humming contentment, the face of a woman who has never been in a bad mood for long.

people.imagined: At the Triều Âm dock, he is carrying a roll of scrolls under his arm and turns his hand to admire a gold-leaf ring too big for his finger, worn on his thumb. He is thinking about how well he forges.
people.subject: The moment: on a harbour dock at the Triều Âm quay he holds up his right hand, thumb extended, to admire a large gold ring on it, with a sly, pleased look at the viewer. Face: a lean, sharp, handsome young face of about twenty-one; quick black eyes; thin arched brows, one raised; a thin nose; a sly, smooth smile; lightly tanned from dock work. A thin line of black ink runs under his thumbnail. Hair: black, in a neat topknot with a gilded pin, a loose strand lifting in the sea wind. Body: wiry, quick, cocky, shoulders back. Clothing: a graceful grey silk robe of a slightly flashier cut than the abbey's, two crossed collars edged in blue-black, a pale gauze over-robe painted with clouds, wide sleeves with ink-stained cuffs; a sash of dark silk with a small brass-gold buckle and a jade pendant. Hands and objects: a thick GOLD ring far too big for his finger worn on the THUMB, clearly visible and gleaming; under his left arm a bundle of narrow scroll rolls with gilt ends; a brush tucked behind his ear. A little gold glint bounces off the ring across his cheekbone. Power: a few thin blue-teal motes of water qi shimmer over his sleeve, faint and playful. Background: a moonlit harbour with soft masts and drifting sea mist, a gull far off. Light: silver moonlight and sea-glow from the upper left, a bright spark on the ring and a soft cool rim light. Expression: a sly, glossy, pleased smile, one brow raised and the eyes bright with the thought of how well he forges, entirely sure of himself.

people.imagined: In the cane grove alone, cutting stalks, he stops and, thinking nobody is looking, taps out brush strokes on his knee with his fingers, a whole sweeping landscape. Then he looks round.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a cut bamboo stalk in a grove he taps the fingers of his right hand on his knee as though tracing brush-strokes, eyes distant, then glances sideways to check he is unseen. Face: a thin, gentle, shy young face of about seventeen; large dark dreamy eyes; soft level brows; a straight small nose; a closed, hiding mouth. A thin sheen of sweat is on his forehead from cutting and a green flake of cane clings to his eyebrow. Hair: black, short, with a straw hat pushed back on his neck. Body: thin, long-limbed, a little stooped. Clothing: a clean, simple jacket of fine grey-green silk with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled to the forearm, the cuffs with a faint ink stain; a cloth belt; trousers rolled to the knee, bare feet in plain straw sandals, a green sap stain on one cuff. He is a mortal-born outer disciple and dressed more simply than the abbey's elders, but everything is clean and soft. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted in mid-stroke with the fingers curved like holding a brush; a short bamboo-cutting knife across his lap; cut green canes at his feet. Power: a few pale green wood-qi motes float up from the cut canes around his hand, very faint. Background: tall green bamboo trunks fading into silver mist, a tiny bright patch of sky. Light: green-gold moon-dappled spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim light on his hair and the canes. Expression: distant, absorbed eyes and a small private half-smile, the face turning guarded as he glances round.

people.imagined: At the Pool House table, sitting on the very edge of her chair, braced, as if the chair might be a trick or the room might shift. She watches the next chair, where her double sits.
people.subject: The moment: seated at the Pool House table, rigidly on the very front edge of a chair, back stiff, both hands gripping the seat edge, eyes darting suspiciously round the room toward the viewer. Face: a narrow, pale, wary face of about twenty-three; wide light-brown eyes with whites showing; fine arched brows drawn tight, one higher than the other; a small pointed nose; a thin tense mouth; a fine film of cold sweat on her upper lip. Hair: dark brown, tied back in a bun with a pale brush pin, a few loose strands tucked tightly behind each ear, one strand across her cheek. Body: slender, braced, tense shoulders, feet flat on the floor as if ready to rise. Clothing: layered undyed grey silk with two crossed collars, the inner one edged with a thin BLUE thread, a pale gauze over-robe painted with faint clouds, wide sleeves with black ink-stained cuffs; a grey sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: her hands white-knuckled on the chair edge; beside her a second identical chair where a pale, faintly translucent paper-like double of herself in the same robe sits calmly, glowing softly; a small bell hangs from the chair-back and a cup of tea at her elbow sits untouched. Power: a faint blue-teal water qi drifts from the double in slow motes. Background: a hushed pale Pool House with a bronze mirror holding cloud-mist and a round window. Light: cool moonlike light from the upper left, a faint blue-green spirit shimmer and a soft rim light. Expression: wide, darting eyes with a tight mouth and a rigid jaw, the face drawn and braced.

people.imagined: On the abbey's terrace at morning, looking up at the sky instead of at the person talking to her, one brush held lightly, deciding today's cloud. She has not heard the question.
people.subject: The moment: standing on the abbey's terrace at dawn, she looks up and slightly away at the sky, one slender hand lifted with a brush, and has clearly not heard what the viewer said. Face: a slight, fine-boned, serene face, ageless though lined, about fifty-five, with small deep lines; pale grey eyes lifted toward the sky; thin silvery brows; a small straight nose; a soft, absent, half-smiling mouth; ink in the creases of the nose-side lines. Hair: pale grey, gathered into a high topknot pinned with a very old brush, the handle dark and chipped, and a slim silver crown-comb behind it. Body: small, slight, straight, nearly weightless, her hem lifting off the stone. Clothing: the head's richest dress: many layers of delicate grey silk, three crossed collars, an outer cloud-painted brocade robe in pearl and ink-grey whose painted clouds seem to drift, long trailing gauze sleeves with the cuffs stained black; a pale grey sash hung with a white jade ring and tassels; on the breast, one small soft grey-white cloud. Hands and objects: ink-stained crease lines in all her fingers; the old brush in her right hand; a roll of unpainted silk under her left arm. Power: a luminous aura of blue-teal and pale green qi, mist-like, rises around her and sheds slow motes like small clouds that drift upward. Background: a vast sky of pale clouds in a sea of mist, a rail of the terrace. Light: radiant pearly dawn light from the upper left with a glowing rim light on her silver hair. Expression: a serene, absent face tilted up, lids half lowered, lips softly closed and eyes lost in the cloud.

people.imagined: At the Pool House with a scroll case in his hand, selling a scroll to a visiting buyer; he smooths the jade weight with his thumb while the buyer thinks about the price. He already knows it.
people.subject: The moment: in the bright Pool House studio he holds a scroll case toward the viewer with a smooth, generous smile, thumb stroking a jade weight at its end, while a buyer unseen is still deciding. Face: a handsome, round, well-fed face of about forty-five; smooth rosy skin; bright, shrewd dark eyes; strong arched brows; a straight nose; full lips in a warm confident smile with a trace of cruelty; a neat, short black beard and moustache. The skin around his eyes is soft and unlined, a prosperous man's face. Hair: black, glossy, in a neat topknot with a jade pin and a small silver crown-band. Body: tall, broad, comfortable. Clothing: an elder's rich dress: lustrous layered grey silk of better cut than the abbey's juniors wear, three crossed collars edged in blue thread, an over-robe of ink-wash brocade painted with clouds and gold-threaded at the hems, wide sleeves with lightly ink-stained cuffs; a broad dark grey sash with a carved jade clasp and tassels. Hands and objects: a long lacquered scroll case with gilt ends and a hanging JADE weight, held out; behind him a round bronze mirror showing a second sky. Power: a visible aura of blue-teal water qi with threads of gold at its edge, glittering motes floating about his shoulders, strongest around the jade. Background: a bright studio of upright scroll stands and a window of soft blue sky, mist drifting in. Light: warm radiant light from the upper left, a gleam on the jade and a glowing rim light. Expression: a smooth, warm, practised smile with a thin edge of coldness in the eyes, the open friendliness of a man who already knows the price.

people.imagined: Standing at a huge sheet of paper at the Pool House, painting fast, sleeves tied back, a smear of blue ink along her jaw. She has been told to sit and has not. She is hunting the sail in the pool.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a huge sheet of paper at the Pool House, painting fast, sleeves tied back, she turns a quick glance at the viewer with a wet brush raised mid-stroke, a long streak of blue ink along her jaw. Face (most important: the blue smear): a thin, sharp, intense face of about thirty-five; a bold smear of bright BLUE ink from the left ear along the jawline, clearly visible; keen dark eyes; strong thin brows; a straight nose; a tight, stubborn mouth; a small crease of concentration between her brows. Hair: black, in a high tight knot pinned by two jade-topped brushes, escaping strands. Body: thin, wiry, upright, always standing. Clothing: a true disciple's finer dress: layered undyed grey silk with a thin BLUE thread at the crossed collars, a gauze over-robe painted with clouds and brushed with blue at the hem, the wide sleeves TIED BACK with cords above the elbow to free the arms, cuffs stained black; a grey sash with a jade pendant. Hands and objects: a wet brush in the right hand dripping blue; before her a tall board with pale paper carrying only a half-painted blue-grey sky with the faint edge of a small white sail; a small mirror-bright dish of blue ink. Power: swirling blue-teal water qi follows the brush, leaving glowing wisps in the air. Background: a long window opens on a dark, still pool with mist above it. Light: bright silvery spirit-light from the upper left, a glowing blue-green reflection from the pool and a crisp rim light on her jaw. Expression: a tight, restless, hunting look, eyes narrowed on something she has not caught yet and the mouth pressed in stubborn impatience.

people.imagined: In the paper mill with a straw hat on indoors and arms wet to the elbows in pulp, he lifts a fresh sheet from the vat and tilts it to the light, counting something in his head and not liking the number.
people.subject: The moment: at a pulp vat in the paper mill, wearing a straw hat indoors and with arms wet to the elbows, he lifts a frame bearing a wet sheet of pale paper and tilts it toward the window light, squinting and counting something in his head. Face: a broad, round, ruddy, tired face of about fifty-five; small shrewd brown eyes in folds; heavy brows; a big nose; a wide, downturned mouth; grey stubble. White flecks of pulp dot his stubble and a pulp-whitened line runs along the hat's edge. Hair: grey, thin, mostly hidden under a wide straw hat. Body: broad, stooped, heavy arms, a barrel chest. Clothing: a steward's robe of fine grey-green silk with two crossed collars, the sleeves rolled to the shoulder for the work; a pale gauze over-robe, clean and softly painted with clouds, tucked back at the waist; his forearms coated pale with white pulp to the elbow, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a wooden mould frame with a wet sheet held up, dripping; behind him stacks of drying paper and a tally of notches; a small wooden tally hooked at the hip with a jade bead. Power: thin green wood-qi and blue-teal motes drift up from the vat with the steam, faint around his hands. Background: soft mill steam and mist, rows of drying sheets, bamboo canes stacked. Light: the window light catches the translucent wet sheet and puts a pale spirit-glow on his face from below, with a silvery rim light. Expression: diligent, deceitful, reclusive; a man who has kept a secret as long as he has kept a vat.

people.imagined: At the soot hearth at Trầm Hương Trấn, she lifts her head at a visitor's step and tucks her burned fingertips into her sleeves at once, as she does whenever anyone looks.
people.subject: The moment: at the soot hearth at Trầm Hương Trấn she lifts her head at a visitor's step and has just tucked both hands inside her wide sleeves, looking up with a calm, polite, closed face. Face: a calm, oval, composed face of about forty-five; pale grey eyes with fine lines; thin straight brows; a small nose with a smudge of soot at the tip; soft thin lips in a small smile; a few fine lines fan from the corners of her eyes. Hair: black with a few grey strands, knotted low and pinned with a plain pale brush, a veil of smoke haze near it. Body: slim, upright, quiet. Clothing: a robe of fine undyed grey silk with two crossed collars, a pale ink-wash gauze over-robe painted with clouds that is clean at the chest and soot-grey along the lower hem, wide sleeves with cuffs stained black with soot and ink; a grey sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: both hands hidden inside her sleeves, only a hint of dark burned fingertips peeking out at one cuff; behind her a clay hearth with a cone of dark soot and a plume of fragrant smoke; a row of small black ink cakes on a rack. Power: the smoke carries slow blue-teal motes that curl into small clouds around her shoulders. Background: a soot-dark hearth room dissolving into brown-grey mist. Light: warm low amber glow from the hearth at the lower left, cool pearly spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light along her cheek. Expression: a calm, polite, closed face, the lips curved in the smallest courteous smile and the pale eyes steady, hiding everything under it.

people.imagined: At a market stall, wearing yet another hat, he spreads out a scroll with a flourish and signs with a gleam in his eye, knowing the buyer will triple the price. He already has a hat for the next market.
people.subject: The moment: at a market stall, wearing yet another hat, he unrolls a scroll with a flourish, one hand lifted to tip his hat to the viewer, a roguish wink; he knows the buyer will triple the price. Face: a quick, lean, young-looking, clean-shaven face of about twenty-eight; bright dark eyes with a wink; thin arched brows; a slim nose; a quick, charming half-grin; a little dimple in his left cheek. Hair: black, glossy, partly covered by a jaunty round red-brown hat with a small feather, a different hat from the last market. Body: slim, lively, a dandy's tilt. Clothing: a flowing grey silk robe of an artful cut with layered crossed collars, an over-robe of pale gauze painted with clouds and gilt at the edge, sleeves rolled back with cuffs black with ink; a bright orange silk scarf at the neck; a broad sash with a jade pendant and a tassel. Hands and objects: on his back a travelling pack with GILT scroll-ends sticking up like a bundle of gold-tipped spears; one hand tipping the hat; a scroll rolled out on the stall before him showing just a soft grey cloud wash (no writing). Power: a few blue-teal motes sparkle around the scroll and tumble up with the gilt glints, playful and faint. Background: a night market of awnings and softly glowing lanterns in red, yellow and green, a crowd blurred in drifting mist. Light: warm lantern light and silver moon-glow from the upper left, a glint on the gilt and a soft rim light. Expression: a quick, roguish wink and a charming half-grin, brows dancing, the face of a rascal delighted by the sale and already thinking of the next hat.

people.imagined: On the abbey step with her sleeve pushed back to show the small inked outline of a brush on the inside of her wrist, she traces it with her other finger, thinking of the only lesson she was given.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stone step of the abbey she pushes back her left sleeve and traces with her right forefinger an inked outline of a brush on the inside of her left wrist, looking down at it, thinking of the only lesson she was given. Face: a plain, round, gentle young face of about eighteen; downcast dark eyes with long lashes casting thin shadows on her cheeks; soft brows; a short nose; a small calm mouth; a small crease of concentration between her brows. Hair: black, in two small buns pinned with brush pins of pale jade, a loose braid down the back. Body: slender, upright, small. Clothing: layered undyed grey silk of simple grace with two crossed collars, a thin ink-wash gauze over-robe painted with a few faint clouds, wide sleeves (the left pushed back to the elbow), cuffs stained black; a grey sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects (the tattoo must read): on the inside of the left wrist, a clearly drawn black outline of a long brush, empty, with nothing filled in, running along the forearm; in the right hand a thin brush with a dry tip; the fingertips only lightly inked, the right index finger fresh and black. Power: a very faint green wood-qi shimmer lies along the inked outline, a mote or two lifting from it. Background: willow branches drooping over a pale wall in soft mist. Light: soft silvery green spirit-light from the upper left through the willow leaves, dappled shade on the wall and a gentle rim light on her cheek. Expression: a humble, shy face with lowered lashes and a faint wistful smile, brows soft as she traces the mark.

people.imagined: Dozing in the shade of the pulp vat with his sleeves dripping, a straw hat on his face, while another boy beats his share of pulp behind him. He is dreaming of clouds.
people.subject: The moment: sprawled in the cool shade beside a pulp vat, his hat over his eyes and one arm flung out, he is deeply asleep with a small smile, dreaming of clouds. Face: a round, boyish, sunburnt face of about seventeen, partly under a hat brim; a loose, smiling mouth slightly open; a short flat nose; freckles; a smear of white pulp on his chin and a thread of drool at the corner of his mouth. Hair: black, short, damp, a cowlick sticking up and a flake of bamboo caught above his ear. Body: sturdy, relaxed, big hands; one leg stretched out and the other knee bent, a bare foot still wet with the toes curled in sleep. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple jacket of fine grey-green silk with sleeves SOAKING WET and heavy with white pulp, visibly dark and dripping, clinging to his arms, the main detail; a crossed collar; wide trousers rolled to the knee and soaked dark with pulp water in drips and spots; a silk cord belt. He is junior and dressed plainly, but everything is clean. Hands and objects: his wet sleeve dripping onto the floor; beside him a wooden beater mallet leaning on a vat; in his fist a scrap of paper with a small painted cloud. Power: faint blue-teal motes of water qi float up from the dripping sleeve and gather in a tiny dream-cloud above his hat. Background: mill vats and steam fading into pale mist, another boy beating pulp out of focus. Light: soft green-grey moonlit shade from the upper left, a gentle rim light along his arm and the drops. Expression: a slack, happy sleeping face under the hat, cheeks relaxed and a small smile at the mouth.

people.imagined: Standing knee-deep in the mangrove shallows with her hems soaked, painting a root. She glances up and grins as if she has just told a lie to a clerk. She is teaching the double to talk.
people.subject: The moment: standing ankle-deep in the shallow brackish water of the mangrove shallows with her hems soaked, she holds a brush mid-stroke over a sheet pinned to a board and looks up with a sly, loyal grin, as if she has just told a lie to a clerk. Face: a sun-browned, strong, bright face of about twenty-four; clever dark eyes with a glint; strongly arched brows; a straight nose; a wide mischievous mouth; fine freckles across the bridge of her nose and a smear of ink on her chin. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a green silk cord and a jade bead, wet at the ends. Body: strong, medium height, planted in the water. Clothing: a flowing grey silk robe with a thin BLUE thread at the collars, a pale gauze over-robe painted with clouds, the hem soaked dark and dripping, clinging round her calves, clearly visible; sleeves rolled up. Both bare forearms are inked with black mangrove-root lines, many tangled branching lines winding from wrist to elbow, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a brush in the right hand, a board with a pinned sheet of a half-painted root; a small ink dish floating on a plank. Power: ripples of blue-teal water qi spread from her ankles and a few green motes lift from the painted root. Background: green mangrove roots arching over brown water in soft mist, a white heron standing far off among the roots. Light: silvery moon-gold spirit-light from the upper left dappling the water, a glittering reflection under her chin and a crisp rim light. Expression: a sly, bright, mischievous grin with a glint in the eye, the face of a girl who would lie to a clerk for a friend and enjoy every word.

people.imagined: In the novices' room, she counts brushes under her breath in a row, chewing at her fingernails, and gives the viewer a quick wary look because she knows she is being added up in turn.
people.subject: The moment: in the novices' room she stands over a row of brushes lined up on a cloth, one fingernail between her teeth, counting under her breath, and sends a quick suspicious glance at the viewer because she knows she is being added up in turn. Face: a thin, sharp young face of about nineteen; restless dark eyes with shadows beneath; thin straight brows; a small nose; a mouth chewing a thumbnail, the nails of both hands bitten down to the raw pink quick, clearly visible; a raw lower lip and a small bitten patch at the corner of the mouth. Hair: dark brown, in a tight braid pinned up with a pale brush, short wisps escaping at her temples, damp with nervous sweat. Body: slim, tense, hunched shoulders. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of clean undyed grey silk, neat, two crossed collars, narrow sleeves with ink-stained cuffs, a thin gauze outer layer faintly painted with a cloud; a grey sash. Being an outer disciple her dress is the plainest of the house, but it is fine and pressed. Hands and objects: the right hand at her mouth with a bitten thumbnail; a long row of exactly twelve thin brushes laid out in a neat line on a pale cloth; a small slate tally of notches. Power: a few nervous green wood-qi motes flicker over the brushes and vanish. Background: a narrow bed with a folded blanket and neatly folded robes dissolving into pale mist, a bare window. Light: cool silver moonlight from the upper left, a faint pale-green glow on the brushes and a thin rim light along her cheek. Expression: a quick, wary, sidelong glance with a bitten fingernail, brows pinched and the mouth tight.

people.imagined: At dusk, an old servant with ink-black ears walks up to the pool to tell his blind master the colour of the clouds, shuffling, his hands full of what he will say.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk an old servant stands at the edge of the pool turning his face toward the sky as if reading it aloud, one hand raised to describe a colour to his blind master. Face (most important: black-rimmed ears): a thin, kindly, old, much-wrinkled face of about eighty; both ears have rims dark with ink, jet black along the whole edge from top to lobe, plainly visible; calm pale brown eyes; sparse white brows; a thin nose; a soft toothless mouth. Deep age spots dot his temples and the skin of his hands is thin as paper. Hair: sparse white, tied in a thin short queue. Body: small, bent, thin, shuffling. Clothing: a servant's jacket of soft grey silk, humble but clean and well pressed, with a crossed collar and short sleeves, a pale cloud-grey gauze wrap over the shoulders; a grey sash; no robe of rank, no ornament but a small old jade bead at the belt. The cuffs are neat though the fingers that poke from them are bent with age. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted, open, describing a cloud; the left hand holds a small ink-stained stone grinder; below, still dark water reflecting a dusk sky of soft pink and violet. Power: a faint blue-teal water-qi glimmer rises from the pool around his raised hand, a few motes like tiny clouds. Background: a dusk pool and a distant island in drifting mist. Light: soft rosy and violet dusk spirit-light from the upper left, a glow on his white hair and a gentle rim light. Expression: a soft, faithful, toothless half-smile, eyes raised and a little misty, the face of a servant who will report the sky exactly as it is.

people.imagined: The founder in his last years, painting old reflections at the pool's edge, brush lifted over a pale sky the pool once held. He is half in the sky himself.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of a still pool an old founder in his last years holds a long thin brush lifted over a sheet, gazing into the water, half in the sky himself; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a long, gaunt, noble, scholarly face of about eighty; a thin white beard to the chest, combed to a thin point; deep-set pale eyes, distant and quiet; long white brows; a high forehead; a gentle line of a mouth. Long fine lines like cracks in old glaze run from his eyes to the temples. Hair: long white hair tied in a topknot with a worn cane brush and a small silver crown-pin. Body: tall, thin, upright with a slight stoop. Clothing: a founder's long robes of fine undyed silk in many floating layers with three crossed collars, an over-robe of pale cloud-painted brocade whose clouds seem to drift, wide trailing sleeves with the cuffs black with ink; a sash hung with a white jade ring; a faint wash of pale cloud pattern at the hem. Hands and objects: a wolf-hair brush with a cane handle in the right hand; a roll of silk across the left arm; below him a round still pool with an upside-down pale sky in it; several drops of dark ink have fallen on the silk before him and spread into soft grey cloud shapes. Power: a faded aura of blue-teal and pale green qi, mist-like, rises around him and thins into motes that become clouds. Background: faded pale sky and mist. Light: soft pale spirit-light from the upper left. The same aged cream tone covers everything, with thin dark craquelure lines across the surface like old varnish. Expression: an absorbed, quiet face with soft eyes fixed on the water and a still, peaceful mouth, the look drifting beyond the paper.

people.imagined: The Pool House painter in the winter of 1158 sitting before her own reflection-double and painting it, the double's face fixed and bright. She leans forward, eager to get the portrait right, unaware.
people.subject: The moment: the Pool House painter, in the winter of 1158, is seated at a table leaning eagerly toward a sheet while, across from her, a pale reflection-double of herself sits upright, its face bright and unmoving; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a handsome, strong, impatient face of about thirty-eight; high cheekbones; keen dark eyes; fine arched brows; a straight nose; a compassionate, slightly open mouth. A thin crease of worry is between her brows and her lips are slightly parted as if about to speak to her double. Hair: black, in a high knot pinned with two jade-topped brushes. Body: slim, leaning forward, tense with eagerness. Clothing: flowing layered undyed grey silk of fine cut with two crossed collars, a thin BLUE thread along the inner edge, a pale gauze over-robe painted with clouds, wide sleeves with cuffs stained black; a sash with a small jade pendant. A little blue ink has dripped onto one sleeve and dried there as a small round blot. Hands and objects: a fine brush held in the right hand; before her a still bowl of water showing the double's face; across the table the pale, slightly translucent double in the same robe, glowing faintly. Power: blue-teal water qi pools in the bowl and rises in a few soft motes toward the double, unnoticed by her. Background: faded pale Pool House walls and a window in mist. Light: low pale winter spirit-light from the upper left, a cold glow on the double's face. The same aged cream tone covers everything, with thin dark craquelure lines across the surface. Expression: ambitious, impatient, compassionate; unaware. Hope and absorption, with no sign of the danger across the table.
